title: S I C C organizational pouch

infobox.effect: Provides 25 inventory slots while only taking up 2

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The S I C C organizational pouch is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 25 inventory slots in a 5x5 grid and only takes up 2 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Currency
- Keys & Keycards
- Posters
- Dogtags
- Physical Bitcoin
- Veritas guitar pick
- Secure Flash drive
- Chain with Prokill medallion
- Gold skull ring

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Stray Dogs
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Keeper's Word

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
Easter eggs and References: The S I C C organizational pouch is modeled on the VERTX large organizational pouch.

The name "S I C C" is a reference to the slang term "sick", and its stylization is inspired by the T H I C C item case.
